narrative_summary: A brief procedure for activating the automatic screenshot function on a Groninger/Fresenius machine HMI.

kips.text: The automatic screenshot function requires a USB drive with drive letter G: connected to the machine HMI
Activation requires logging in with user gronservice2
The activation procedure navigates to Service, Bedientableau, Inbetriebnahme, then enables Fernwartung, Display access level, and Automatischer Bildschirmdruck
Active status of the automatic screenshot function is visible in the HMI status bar
